input: Give a regional museum a distinctive website direction; no code yet.
objective_checks: Output contains concept, visual rules and tradeoffs; no source files change
human_criteria: Direction fits visitors planning a visit and preserves institutional credibility
failure_conditions: Generic adjective list; implementing despite no-code request

input: Critique this landing page without editing it.
objective_checks: Identify the unlabeled email input from markup; mark rendered hierarchy pending unless actually viewed
human_criteria: Prioritize form completion over decorative changes
failure_conditions: Claiming browser inspection from source alone; changing files

input: Fix the cart total updating one click late; preserve this React app's styling.
objective_checks: Use the current quantity to derive total; preserve the product and controls
human_criteria: Fix addresses state ownership without a framework rewrite
failure_conditions: Replacing app structure or styling

input: Fix narrow-screen overflow in the gallery toolbar.
objective_checks: Identify fixed width; make controls reflow; verify rendered 320px and 360px layouts if tools exist
human_criteria: Controls remain readable and artwork stays dominant

input: Translate the supplied SVG layout reference into a reusable specification; do not implement.

human_criteria: Explain layout relationships rather than copying a brand
failure_conditions: Treating a static reference as proof of responsive behavior

objective_checks: Scene state is reproducible and export uses that same state; inspect downloaded PNG if possible
human_criteria: Composition has hierarchy and intentional variation

objective_checks: Specify core loop, input alternatives, solvability and restart states
human_criteria: Difficulty comes from meaningful choices rather than poor controls
failure_conditions: Making targets smaller to increase difficulty

input: Explore useful tools for people learning colour; give three distinct ideas.
objective_checks: Options differ in core loop; each includes a small validation experiment
human_criteria: Concepts offer different value mechanisms and feasible scope
failure_conditions: Three reskins of the same chat app

objective_checks: Define main job, must/next/omit and disconfirmation condition
human_criteria: Keep a complete valuable loop while reducing complexity
failure_conditions: Deleting export without asking how users use palettes

input: Unify inconsistent button styles using existing tokens only.
objective_checks: Inspect existing tokens and variants; change only inconsistent usages
human_criteria: Retain intentional semantic variants
failure_conditions: Creating another token system

input: Improve keyboard use and accessible labels in this form.
objective_checks: Give email input an associated visible label; verify tab/focus behavior
human_criteria: Errors and recovery remain understandable
failure_conditions: Claiming complete accessibility from a static scan

input: Review our animated background's jank; don't modify code yet.
objective_checks: Request or inspect traces; separate measured bottlenecks from hypotheses
human_criteria: Keep useful ambience if affordable; prioritize input
failure_conditions: Inventing FPS or deleting animation purely by taste

input: Keep this maximalist festival identity and make ticket selection clearer.
objective_checks: Preserve saturated palette and expressive type; improve ticket flow only
human_criteria: Solution works within the requested visual language
failure_conditions: Imposing monochrome minimalism

human_criteria: Distinguish categorical colour from semantic status and decorative variation

objective_checks: Prioritize core navigation, loading/error and usable controls based on available evidence
human_criteria: Avoid polishing peripheral elements before the map task works
failure_conditions: Repository-wide audit or invented runtime results

objective_checks: Map surface/ink/accent/status tokens and test real contrast pairs
human_criteria: Theme preserves editorial hierarchy and identity

objective_checks: Define information carried by motion and static equivalents
human_criteria: Motion helps orientation without overwhelming the data
failure_conditions: Blanket ban on all animation

human_criteria: AI adds clear user value where interpretation matters

human_criteria: Avoid unrelated UI redesign

human_criteria: Distinguish silhouette/structure variety from colour-only variation

human_criteria: Keep rendering stable across aspect ratios
